title: Electro-Magnetic Compatibility
description: Electro-Magnetic Compatibility as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are EMC-sensitive and EMC-emitting items in or near the installation identified?
Is the EMC zone of the installation identified?
Are lightning strike and static discharge considerations identified?
Are screening, segregation and bonding measures defined for the EMC zone?
Is lightning current path continuity assessed for external and fuel-zone items?
Are EMC requirements flowed to bought-in equipment specifications?
Are EMC and lightning protection features shown on the released definitions?
Is EMC qualification evidence available or planned for bought-in equipment?
Are EMC test requirements for the installed configuration defined?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
